info.title: Akta Private Market Data API
info.description: Private company intelligence: enrich 20M+ companies across 16 sections (firmographics, funding rounds, M&A, financial estimates, management, and more), build targeted company lists from structured filters or natural language, and resolve companies and industries from free text.

tags.name: Company Data
tags.description: Enrich a single company by section: firmographics, funding, M&A, financials, management

tags.name: Company Discovery
tags.description: Build targeted company lists from structured filters or natural language

tags.name: Supporting
tags.description: Entity resolution for companies and industries

x-aisa-pricing.formula: per-section credits x2; e.g. firmographic (2cr) $0.16, funding_detail (3cr) $0.24, mna_and_investment (5cr) $0.40

get.description: Enrich one private company across 16 sections and 75+ data points. `company` accepts a website (canva.com) or a UUID from company search. `sections` is a comma-separated list; billing follows akta's per-section credits (x2 customer multiplier): firmographic/business_model/company_assessment/technology/product_offering (2cr, $0.16), strategic_signal (1.5cr, $0.12), management_profile/customer_profile/industry (1cr, $0.08), trust_signal/company_hierarchy/digital_presence/financial_estimate/location (0.5cr, $0.04), funding_detail (3cr, $0.24), mna_and_investment (5cr, $0.40). Use funding_detail for rounds, investors, and total raised; use mna_and_investment for acquisitions and investments.

parameters.name: company
parameters.description: Company website (e.g. canva.com) or company UUID from company search.

parameters.name: sections
parameters.description: Comma-separated section list. One of: firmographic, business_model, company_assessment, trust_signal, company_hierarchy, digital_presence, financial_estimate, funding_detail, location, mna_and_investment, management_profile, product_offering, strategic_signal, customer_profile, industry, technology.

200.description: Company profile with the requested sections.

post.description: Build a targeted company list from structured filters or a natural-language query, with optional per-section enrichment. Use filter-builder first to turn plain language into a reviewable filters object, then pass it here. Pricing: base $0.05 + $0.40 per returned company when enrichment sections are requested.

query.description: Natural-language description of target companies (adds $0.10 surcharge; prefer filters for repeatability).

filters.description: Structured filters from filter-builder (dotted-path keys, e.g. location.hq.city, funding_detail.funding_overview.funding_stage, industry.industry).

sections.description: Optional enrichment sections per returned company (same section names as company enrichment).

limit.description: Max companies to return (total capped at 500).

post.description: Convert a natural-language description of target companies into a structured filters object for list generation. Reviewable, tweakable, and reusable — costs the same $0.025 as the natural-language surcharge but the output can be cached and re-run. Returns no companies itself.

query.description: e.g. 'series a companies in mumbai working in climate tech'.

get.description: Resolve a company from a name, website, or UUID and get its core identity: uuid, name, website, product_category, company_status. The first step before enrichment when you only have a fuzzy name.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Company name, website, or UUID. Input type is auto-detected.

get.description: Resolve an industry from free text into akta's 4-level taxonomy codes (30K+ sub-sectors), ranked by similarity. Use the codes in list-generation industry filters.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Free-text industry or topic, e.g. 'warehouse automation'.

parameters.name: level
parameters.description: Taxonomy level: l1, l2, l3, l4, all, or comma-separated list. Default l4.

200.description: Ranked industry codes with similarity scores.

get.description: Poll the status of an asynchronous akta request (e.g. a company addition) by its request_id.

parameters.name: request_id
parameters.description: The request UUID returned by the originating call.

200.description: Current request status and type-specific detail.
